text: Entry Requirements People who intend to study in China; Those who intend to work in China; People who are interested in Chinese language and plan to learn systematically; Ethnic Chinese abroad or people whose mother tongue is Chinese who are interested in learning Chinese or who want to return or work in China; Extended learning for current students. Note: The amount of courses you need to take is decided by teachers' interview. After admitted, you must pay tuition fee to CUCAS.
